Ollama

A local-model option for the right workload.

OOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Run supported language models through Ollama's local API for controlled application workloads. MoreSpace can evaluate a self-hosted assistant, document extraction service, or developer sandbox when hardware capacity, data boundaries, and model quality support the requirement. We compare local models against representative business tasks and keep retrieval, permissions, and logging explicit rather than assuming local deployment alone solves every operational concern.

Useful outputs

  • Locally served model responses
  • Evaluation and performance reports
  • An operator-controlled internal prototype

Where we can apply it

  • Approved documents → local extraction → reviewer validation → internal database.
  • Acceptance examples → model evaluation → capacity review → deployment decision.
  • Internal question → permitted retrieval → local answer draft → human escalation.
01

Use case 1

Prototype a local document-summary or extraction service.

02

Use case 2

Evaluate selected open models against a business acceptance set.

03

Use case 3

Build an internal assistant over an approved knowledge collection.

Inputs we need

  • A licensed supported model
  • Approved task inputs and knowledge
  • Available compute and deployment limits

Delivery sequence

  • Choose candidate models and size the required computing environment.
  • Connect the local API and validate structured or tool-based responses.
  • Measure task quality and load before deciding whether to productionize.

Expert review points

  • Confirm model licensing and the actual data path of every integration.
  • Test factual accuracy, access boundaries, and operational recovery.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

Signals we can make visible

  • Task acceptance rate
  • Inference latency
  • Hardware utilization
  • Operating cost per accepted task
